index.title: BeagleEditor — Your Happy Little Coding Workbench
index.body:
Your friendly neighborhood code editor

Less fuss.
More “aha!”

Pop open a file, chase that shiny new idea, squash a pesky bug, and get back to making cool stuff. Your code deserves a comfy home.

Grab BeagleEditor ↗Peek under the hood →

For Windows, macOS, and Linux · Open source

BE / 01

THE BIG LITTLE IDEA

Open the file.
Catch the spark. Keep rolling.

Your editor should help you untangle the tricky bits—not become another puzzle to solve.

SKIP THE FOLDER MAZE

Know the name?
You're already there.

Open Quick Open, type a few letters, and jump directly to the file you had in mind. Less clicking through folders, more time with the problem you're solving.

Learn the navigation shortcuts →

SEE THE SHAPE OF YOUR PROJECT

Every file has
a place.

Browse folders, create files, and keep the structure of your project close to the code you're editing—all in one workspace.

Explore workspace tools →

KEEP YOUR BEARINGS

Make a change.
See what moved.

Review the working-tree changes from your editor and keep Git close at hand as your idea turns into something real.

Read about workspace tools →

YOUR EVERYDAY TOOLKIT

The handy stuff,
right where you need it.

From tiny tweaks to big “wait, what if…” moments, familiar tools help you stay in the coding groove.

01

Make code easy on the eyes

Syntax highlighting adds helpful color and structure, without turning your workspace into a disco dashboard.

↗
02

Ride the flow

Autocomplete and practical editing helpers take care of repetitive bits, so your brain can stay on the fun stuff.

↗
03

Speak more than one code-language

Keep Python, C and C++, web files, and other projects in one familiar little workspace.

↗

TAKE A PEEK

Useful tools.
No circus.

Keep your eyes on the code while the editor keeps the rest of the scene tidy.

See the editor in action →

THE WHOLE WORKSPACE

Less window
hopping. More making.

Keep the everyday project tools close by, from the first file you open to the command that checks your work.

01 / EXPLORE
⌘

Find your way around

Browse project files, create folders, and jump to a file by name without digging through windows.

Explore workspace tools →
02 / SEARCH
⌕

Follow the thread

Search through readable project files and move from a match straight to the line that matters.

Browse the guides →
03 / SOURCE CONTROL
⑂

Keep track of changes

Review working-tree changes and use Git from the editor when it is time to save a checkpoint.

See the features →
04 / TERMINAL
>_

Run it right here

Open a real shell, run project commands, and keep terminal sessions nearby while you edit.

Read the documentation →

FROM FIRST DRAFT TO DEEPER TOOLS

Code in color.
Go further when you’re ready.

Syntax highlighting helps make code readable at a glance. For languages with compatible language-server tooling installed, BeagleEditor can also surface richer assistance such as diagnostics, completion, hover details, and formatting.

Explore language support →

YOUR WORKSPACE, YOUR WAY

A WORKBENCH THAT FEELS LIKE YOURS

Make it fit
your way of working.

Choose a light or dark interface, add a JSON color theme, or build a small JavaScript extension to add your own command. BeagleEditor keeps customization approachable—and explicit.

Create a color theme →Build your first extension →

SMALL, MIGHTY, HANDY

Hop in. Make stuff.

Some days call for a giant IDE. Other days, you just need a trusty spot to edit a file and get on with the adventure. That’s BeagleEditor.

Find your way around →

PSSST… YOUR NEXT IDEA IS WAITING

Let’s make
something.

Download the editor, or wander over to the source and see what we’re tinkering with.

Pick your platform ↗Explore the code cave →
BE.

features.title: BeagleEditor - Features
features.body:
Features

A lightweight editor with powerful tools for everyday programming.

⚡ Fast and Lightweight

BeagleEditor focuses on speed and responsiveness. Open files quickly and stay productive.

📂 Explorer

Open folders and manage projects easily with an integrated file explorer.

🔍 Quick Open

Find files instantly using fuzzy search.

📑 Tabs

Work with multiple files without reopening them.

📝 Markdown Preview

Preview Markdown documents with live rendering.

🌈 Themes

Customize your editor with beautiful themes.

🧩 Plugins

Extend BeagleEditor with community plugins.

💻 Multi-language Support

Write code in Python, C, C++, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and more.

<style>
      /* ==========================================================
     DOWNLOAD PAGE — STEP-BY-STEP EXPERIENCE
     ========================================================== */

      .download-page {
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      /* ==========================================================
     SHARED
     ========================================================== */

      .download-step {
        min-height: 100vh;
        min-height: 100svh;

        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;

        padding: 100px 40px;

        position: relative;
      }

      .download-step-inner {
        width: min(1200px, 100%);

        margin: auto;

        text-align: center;
      }

      .download-step h1,
      .download-step h2 {
        letter-spacing: -0.065em;
        line-height: 0.98;
      }

      .download-step h2 {
        font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 6rem);
      }

      .download-step-description {
        max-width: 650px;

        margin: 30px auto 0;

        color: var(--text-secondary);

        font-size: 1.2rem;
      }

      /* ==========================================================
     STEP INDICATOR
     ========================================================== */

      .download-progress {
        position: fixed;

        right: 28px;
        top: 50%;

        z-index: 900;

        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;

        gap: 10px;

        transform: translateY(-50%);
      }

      .download-progress-dot {
        width: 9px;
        height: 9px;

        padding: 0;

        border: none;
        border-radius: 50%;

        background: var(--border);

        cursor: pointer;

        transition:
          transform 0.3s ease,
          background 0.3s ease;
      }

      .download-progress-dot.active {
        background: var(--primary);

        transform: scale(1.45);
      }

      /* ==========================================================
     STEP 01 — HERO
     ========================================================== */

      .download-step-hero {
        min-height: calc(100vh - 90px);
        min-height: calc(100svh - 90px);
      }

      .download-step-hero .download-step-inner {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
      }

      .download-step-hero h1 {
        max-width: 1000px;

        margin: 0;

        font-size: clamp(4rem, 10vw, 8rem);

        font-weight: 900;
      }

      .download-step-hero h1 span {
        display: block;

        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));

        -webkit-background-clip: text;
        background-clip: text;

        color: transparent;
      }

      .download-scroll-hint {
        margin-top: 70px;

        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;

        gap: 12px;

        color: var(--text-secondary);

        font-size: 0.8rem;
        font-weight: 600;

        letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        text-transform: uppercase;

        animation: downloadScrollHint 2s ease-in-out infinite;
      }

      .download-scroll-arrow {
        font-size: 1.5rem;
      }

      @keyframes downloadScrollHint {
        0%,
        100% {
          transform: translateY(0);
          opacity: 0.6;
        }

        50% {
          transform: translateY(8px);
          opacity: 1;
        }
      }

      /* ==========================================================
     STEP 02 — PLATFORM
     ========================================================== */

      .download-platform-step {
        background: radial-gradient(
          circle at 50% 45%,
          rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.12),
          transparent 40%
        );
      }

      .platform-step-heading {
        margin-bottom: 70px;
      }

      .platform-step-heading h2 {
        margin-bottom: 20px;
      }

      .platform-step-heading p {
        max-width: 600px;

        margin: auto;

        font-size: 1.15rem;
      }

      .platform-grid {
        display: grid;

        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));

        gap: 25px;

        width: min(1000px, 100%);

        margin: auto;
      }

      .platform-option {
        appearance: none;

        min-height: 280px;

        padding: 40px 30px;

        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;

        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;

        gap: 14px;

        font-family: inherit;

        text-align: center;

        background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.85);

        border: 1px solid var(--border);

        border-radius: 30px;

        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);

        cursor: pointer;

        transition:
          transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
          box-shadow 0.4s ease,
          border-color 0.3s ease,
          background 0.3s ease;
      }

      .platform-option:hover {
        transform: translateY(-12px);

        background: white;

        border-color: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3);

        box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      }

      .platform-option.selected {
        transform: translateY(-10px) scale(1.025);

        background: white;

        border-color: var(--primary);

        box-shadow:
          0 25px 70px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.18),
          0 0 0 4px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.08);
      }

      .platform-option-icon {
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;

        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        margin-bottom: 10px;
        color: var(--text);
      }

      .platform-option-icon svg,
      .download-platform-icon svg {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
      }

      .platform-option[data-os="windows"] .platform-option-icon { color: #0078d4; }
      .platform-option[data-os="mac"] .platform-option-icon { color: #171717; }
      .platform-option[data-os="linux"] .platform-option-icon { color: #242424; }

      .platform-option-name {
        color: var(--text);

        font-size: 1.3rem;
        font-weight: 700;
      }

      .platform-option-description {
        color: var(--text-secondary);

        font-size: 0.9rem;
      }

      /* ==========================================================
     STEP 03 — DOWNLOAD
     ========================================================== */

      .download-download-step {
        background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #eef2ff, #ffffff 65%);
      }

      .download-card {
        width: min(950px, 100%);

        margin: 60px auto 0;

        padding: 60px;

        display: grid;

        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

        align-items: center;

        gap: 60px;

        text-align: left;

        border-radius: 35px;

        background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.85);

        border: 1px solid var(--border);

        box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);

        backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      }

      .download-card h3 {
        margin-bottom: 15px;

        font-size: 2rem;
      }

      .download-card p {
        margin: 0;

        font-size: 1.05rem;
      }

      .download-card .button {
        margin-top: 30px;
      }

      .download-platform-icon {
        width: 110px;
        height: 110px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: flex-start;
        margin-bottom: 25px;
        color: var(--text);
      }

      .download-platform-icon[data-os="windows"] { color: #0078d4; }
      .download-platform-icon[data-os="mac"] { color: #171717; }
      .download-platform-icon[data-os="linux"] { color: #242424; }

      /* ==========================================================
     TERMINAL
     ========================================================== */

      .download-terminal {
        overflow: hidden;

        border-radius: 22px;

        background: #111827;

        box-shadow: 0 35px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);

        transform: rotate(2deg);

        transition: transform 0.4s ease;
      }

      .download-terminal:hover {
        transform: rotate(0) scale(1.02);
      }

      .terminal-header {
        height: 45px;

        display: flex;
        align-items: center;

        padding: 0 15px;

        background: #f3f4f6;

        color: #4b5563;

        font-size: 0.8rem;
      }

      .terminal-header > span {
        margin-left: 15px;

        font-weight: 600;
      }

      .terminal-body {
        min-height: 180px;

        padding: 30px;

        display: flex;
        align-items: flex-start;

        gap: 12px;

        color: #d1d5db;

        font-family:
          "SFMono-Regular", "Cascadia Code", "JetBrains Mono", monospace;

        font-size: 0.9rem;

        line-height: 1.7;
      }

      .terminal-prompt {
        color: #60a5fa;
      }

      #install-command {
        white-space: pre-wrap;
      }

      /* ==========================================================
     STEP 04 — INSTALL
     ========================================================== */

      .download-install-step {
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff, #f8fafc);
      }

      .install-layout {
        width: min(1000px, 100%);

        margin: 70px auto 0;

        display: grid;

        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));

        gap: 25px;
      }

      .install-step {
        padding: 40px 30px;

        text-align: left;

        border-radius: 26px;

        background: white;

        border: 1px solid var(--border);

        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);

        transition:
          transform 0.4s ease,
          box-shadow 0.4s ease;
      }

      .install-step:hover {
        transform: translateY(-8px);

        box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      }

      .install-number {
        width: 45px;
        height: 45px;

        display: flex;

        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;

        margin-bottom: 30px;

        border-radius: 14px;

        background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.1);

        color: var(--primary);

        font-weight: 800;
      }

      .install-step h3 {
        margin-bottom: 12px;

        font-size: 1.35rem;
      }

      .install-step p {
        margin: 0;
      }

      /* ==========================================================
     STEP 05 — LAUNCH
     ========================================================== */

      .download-launch-step {
        background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #eef2ff, #ffffff 65%);
      }

      .launch-icon {
        width: 150px;
        height: 150px;

        display: flex;

        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;

        margin: 0 auto 45px;

        border-radius: 42px;

        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));

        color: white;

        font-size: 4.5rem;

        box-shadow: 0 35px 80px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3);

        animation: launchFloat 4s ease-in-out infinite;
      }

      @keyframes launchFloat {
        0%,
        100% {
          transform: translateY(0);
        }

        50% {
          transform: translateY(-14px);
        }
      }

      .launch-button {
        margin-top: 40px;
      }

      /* ==========================================================
     STEP 06 — FINAL CTA
     ========================================================== */

      .download-final-step {
        min-height: 90vh;

        background: url("assets/gradient.png") center / cover;

        color: white;
      }

      .download-final-step::before {
        content: "";

        position: absolute;

        inset: 0;

        background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.4);
      }

      .download-final-step-inner {
        position: relative;

        z-index: 1;
      }

      .download-final-step .eyebrow {
        color: white;
      }

      .download-final-step h2 {
        color: white;

        font-size: clamp(4rem, 9vw, 8rem);
      }

      .download-final-step p {
        max-width: 650px;

        margin: 30px auto 40px;

        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);

        font-size: 1.2rem;
      }

      .download-final-step .button.primary {
        background: white;

        color: var(--primary);

        box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
      }

      /* ==========================================================
     REVEAL
     ========================================================== */

      .download-reveal {
        opacity: 0;

        transform: translateY(50px);

        transition:
          opacity 0.9s ease,
          transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
      }

      .download-reveal.visible {
        opacity: 1;

        transform: translateY(0);
      }

      /* ==========================================================
     RESPONSIVE
     ========================================================== */

      @media (max-width: 900px) {
        .download-step {
          padding: 100px 30px;
        }

        .platform-grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }

        .platform-option {
          min-height: 220px;
        }

        .download-card {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;

          padding: 45px;

          gap: 45px;
        }

        .install-layout {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }

        .download-progress {
          display: none;
        }
      }

      @media (max-width: 600px) {
        .download-step {
          padding: 80px 20px;
        }

        .download-step-hero h1 {
          font-size: 3.7rem;
        }

        .download-step h2 {
          font-size: 3rem;
        }

        .download-step-description {
          font-size: 1rem;
        }

        .download-card {
          padding: 30px 25px;

          border-radius: 25px;
        }

        .download-terminal {
          transform: none;
        }

        .download-terminal:hover {
          transform: none;
        }

        .terminal-body {
          padding: 22px;

          font-size: 0.8rem;
        }

        .launch-icon {
          width: 120px;
          height: 120px;

          border-radius: 34px;

          font-size: 3.5rem;
        }

        .download-final-step h2 {
          font-size: 3.8rem;
        }
      }

      /* ==========================================================
     REDUCED MOTION
     ========================================================== */

      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        html {
          scroll-behavior: auto;
        }

        .download-scroll-hint,
        .launch-icon {
          animation: none !important;
        }

        .download-reveal {
          opacity: 1 !important;

          transform: none !important;

          transition: none !important;
        }

        .platform-option,
        .install-step {
          transition: none !important;
        }
      }
    </style>

roadmap.title: BeagleEditor - Roadmap
roadmap.body:
Roadmap

Where BeagleEditor is today—and where we want to take it next. Priorities may change as the project evolves.

Available now

  • Workspace Explorer, file operations, and multi-tab editing
  • Quick Open and command palette
  • Session restoration and recent workspaces
  • Markdown preview with synchronized scrolling
  • Integrated terminal, search, Git, and Problems panels
  • Language-server diagnostics, completion, navigation, and formatting
  • JavaScript extensions and installable JSON color themes
  • Run and debug workflows

Near-term priorities

  • Make extension discovery, installation, and management smoother
  • Improve reliability and responsiveness in larger workspaces
  • Refine terminal, Git, and debugging workflows
  • Broaden language-server guidance and compatibility testing
  • Polish keyboard navigation, accessibility, and small-screen layouts

Longer-term direction

  • More useful workspace-wide navigation and code intelligence
  • A clearer, more capable extension ecosystem with better discovery and documentation
  • More flexible editor customization and workspace preferences
  • Consistent packaging and release experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux

This roadmap describes current direction, not guaranteed release dates. Follow development and report issues on GitHub.

BEAGLEEDITOR · DOCUMENTATION

Welcome to BeagleEditor

BeagleEditor is a desktop code editor built with React, Monaco Editor, Rust, and Tauri 2. Use these guides to learn the interface, configure the editor, and extend it.

User guides

GuideWhat you'll learn
Getting startedOpen a folder, edit files, and learn the main interface.
Keyboard shortcutsOpen files, run commands, and navigate quickly.
Editor settings and themesCustomize typography, editing behavior, and color themes.
Workspace toolsUse Explorer, workspace search, Git, terminal, and Problems.
Language supportConfigure language servers for diagnostics and code intelligence.
TroubleshootingDiagnose common installation, language-server, and extension issues.

Developer guides

GuideWhat you'll learn
Extension developmentBuild JavaScript extensions and JSON-only color themes.
Development setupInstall prerequisites, run the app, test changes, and build packages.

Need help?

If a feature behaves differently than documented, first check the version you're running and consult Troubleshooting. When reporting a bug, include your operating system, BeagleEditor version, reproducible steps, and relevant error output. Remove private paths, credentials, and source code you don't want to share.
